_comment: Command-line tools Armature expects on each machine, with pinned versions. Install or check them with plugins/core/bin/setup-tools.py. Each tool is installed once per machine (bun global folder, Playwright browser cache), never inside Armature or a project. Order matters for --install: playwright-core installs the browser and its ffmpeg. The quality gates (review/quality.py, the pre-commit hook) use gitleaks, osv-scanner, knip, jscpd, vulture and semgrep; gitleaks and osv-scanner install from a pinned download (sha256 checked) on linux-x86_64, and the pre-commit hook installs gitleaks on first use; Each repo's own CI installs the same versions (Armature ships no CI).

tools.name: bun
tools.purpose: Installs the JavaScript tools below into its global folder

tools.name: node
tools.purpose: Runs the walkthrough recorder (plugins/core/bin/record-walkthrough.mjs) and the likec4 CLI
tools.install_hint: install Node.js 22 or newer (nvm, fnm or the OS package)

tools.name: likec4
tools.purpose: Architecture and pipeline model as text: validate, export PNG, build the static site for the walkthroughs

tools.name: playwright-core
tools.purpose: Drives Chromium to record the dynamic-view walkthroughs. Same version as the Playwright that likec4 1.61.0 bundles, so both use one browser revision

tools.name: chromium-headless-shell
tools.purpose: Browser for likec4 export png and the walkthrough recorder (revision of playwright-core 1.64.1)

tools.name: playwright-ffmpeg
tools.purpose: Playwright's own ffmpeg build, used to record the page video (WebM)

tools.name: ffmpeg-static
tools.purpose: Full ffmpeg (6.0, with libx264) to convert the recordings to MP4 H.264

tools.name: specify-cli
tools.purpose: Spec Kit CLI (specify): sdd-init.sh runs its init; `armature speckit` reports repo versions against this pin and prints the upgrade path. Keep the version equal to SPEC_KIT_VERSION in plugins/core/bin/sdd-init.sh

tools.name: gitleaks
tools.purpose: Secret scanner: the pre-commit hook (staged changes) and the secrets check of PR Validation (the PR's commits). MIT
tools.install_hint: download gitleaks_8.30.1_<os>_<arch>.tar.gz from https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/tag/v8.30.1, check it against gitleaks_8.30.1_checksums.txt (sha256sum -c --ignore-missing), put gitleaks in ~/.local/bin

tools.name: osv-scanner
tools.purpose: Known vulnerabilities in the lockfiles a PR changes (dependencies check of PR Validation). Apache-2.0
tools.install_hint: download osv-scanner_<os>_<arch> from https://github.com/google/osv-scanner/releases/tag/v2.7.0, check it against osv-scanner_SHA256SUMS, install it as ~/.local/bin/osv-scanner

tools.name: knip
tools.purpose: Unused files, exports and dependencies in TypeScript/JavaScript (dead-code check). ISC

tools.name: jscpd
tools.purpose: Copy-paste detection: clones a PR introduces (duplication check). MIT

tools.name: semgrep
tools.purpose: Static analysis rules of PR Validation (review/lanes.py: .armature/semgrep and the skills' semgrep rules). LGPL-2.1, run as a tool
